docTitle: Accessory Dwelling Unit Submittal Requirements Checklist (Z412, Nov 2025)

items.text: Sewer deficiency verification from Public Works. Email request; allow up to four days.
Meter spot report, if adding, upgrading or moving an electric meter.

JADUs only: owner-occupancy covenant, required by AMC 18.38.015.110 and authorized by the California Government Code Sections 65852.2 and 65852.22. Drafted by the City Attorney and recorded before permit issuance.
Title report (prepared within the last 6 months).
